name: FiveMinChat – AI Chatbot Widget
author: vibgyortechsolutions

sections.description:
FiveMinChat (also written FiveMin Chat or Five Min Chat) lets you add an AI chatbot, trained on your own website and documents, to any WordPress site by entering a single Bot ID.

Once activated and configured, the plugin loads the FiveMinChat widget script on every public page, so your visitors can start chatting immediately – without you touching a single line of code.

Pricing:

  • Free plan, forever: 100 messages a month, 15 crawled website pages and 1 uploaded file. No credit card needed. The plugin itself is free.
  • 7-day trial at Starter limits (1,000 messages a month) for every new account. If you do not subscribe, your bot is not switched off – it moves to the Free plan.
  • Paid plans from Rs 499 / US$5.99 a month (Starter), Rs 999 / US$11.99 (Growth) and Rs 1,999 / US$23.99 (Pro). Rupee prices include GST.

Plans are counted in visitor messages, not conversations. Full details: fiveminchat.com/pricing

How it works:

  1. Sign up at fiveminchat.com and create your AI chatbot.
  2. Copy your Bot ID from the FiveMinChat dashboard (Settings page).
  3. Paste the Bot ID into the plugin settings under Settings > FiveMinChat.
  4. Save – the widget is live on your site.

Features:

  • One field, one save, done.
  • Works on every page and post automatically.
  • Lightweight: loads a single deferred script in the footer, no extra CSS or assets.
  • No shortcodes or blocks required.
  • Bot ID is validated as a UUID v4 before saving and before output. The widget script URL is fixed and never user-controlled.
  • Settings require the manage_options capability and are protected by WordPress nonces.
  • Clean uninstall: deleting the plugin removes its stored settings (including on multisite).

External services

This plugin connects to the FiveMinChat service, operated by Vibgyor Techsolutions, to show an AI chatbot on your site. The chatbot cannot work without it.

  • Widget script – on every public page (only after you save a Bot ID), visitors’ browsers load https://cdn.fiveminchat.com/widget.js. The request sends the usual browser data (IP address, user agent, referring page URL).
  • Chat API – when a visitor sends a message, the widget sends your Bot ID, the message, the recent chat history and a random session ID to https://api.fiveminchat.com. If the visitor types their name, email or phone number into the chat, that text is sent too, so the site owner can follow up.

No data is sent from your WordPress admin, and nothing is loaded until a Bot ID is saved.

  • Terms of Service: https://fiveminchat.com/terms.html
  • Privacy Policy: https://fiveminchat.com/privacy-policy.html
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress go to Plugins > Add New, search for “FiveMinChat”, then click Install Now and Activate. Or upload the fiveminchat folder to /wp-content/plugins/ and activate it on the Plugins screen.
  2. Go to Settings > FiveMinChat, paste your Bot ID from the FiveMinChat dashboard, and click Save Settings.
sections.faq:
Is FiveMinChat free?

Yes. The plugin is free, and FiveMinChat has a permanent Free plan with 100 messages a month, 15 crawled pages and 1 uploaded file – no credit card and no time limit. New accounts also get a 7-day trial at Starter limits; when it ends without a subscription, the bot keeps running on the Free plan. Paid plans start at Rs 499 (US$5.99) a month.

Where do I find my Bot ID?

Log in to your FiveMinChat dashboard at app.fiveminchat.com and open the Settings page. Your Bot ID looks like xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx.

The widget is not appearing on my site. What should I check?

  • You have saved a valid Bot ID in Settings > FiveMinChat. The status on that page tells you whether the widget is active.
  • Your theme calls wp_footer(). Nearly all themes do, but some custom themes omit it.
  • You are viewing a public page, not wp-admin – the widget is not loaded in the admin area.
  • You have cleared your caching plugin (if any) after saving the Bot ID.

Does this plugin slow down my site?

No. The widget script is loaded in the footer with the defer attribute, so it downloads in the background and runs after the page has finished parsing.

Can I show the widget only on specific pages?

The current version shows the widget on all public pages. Per-page control is planned for a future release.

Is a FiveMinChat account required?

Yes. The plugin connects your site to a chatbot you create at fiveminchat.com. Creating an account is free, and you can stay on the permanent Free plan (100 messages a month) for as long as you like.
sections.changelog:
1.0.3

  • Widget script is now loaded with wp_enqueue_script() (footer, defer strategy) instead of a raw script tag.
  • Added a Settings link on the Plugins screen and a one-time onboarding notice after activation.
  • Documented the external FiveMinChat service in the readme.
  • Tested up to WordPress 7.1.

1.0.1

  • Packaged under a fiveminchat/ folder so it always installs to wp-content/plugins/fiveminchat/.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
